categories.main_business_segments: Tong Petrotech Corp. primarily operates in oilfield development technical support and services, focusing on integrated drilling and completion services including directional drilling, logging, perforating, and fracturing stimulation. The company also develops strategic businesses in clean energy and carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) to support green and low-carbon energy transitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is advanced perforating technology, including pump-down perforating with intelligent and automated features. It also employs directional drilling technologies (MWD, LWD), logging services, fracturing stimulation including explosive fracturing, and CO2 enhanced oil recovery (CCUS-EOR) technologies. R&D focuses on upgrading perforating tools, fracturing fluids, and CO2 injection techniques to improve oil recovery and reduce emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major oil and gas companies such as Chevron, Occidental Petroleum, and China’s national oil companies (CNPC, Sinopec). The company serves upstream oil and gas exploration and development sectors, with a focus on unconventional resources like shale oil and gas. Markets include North America, China’s major oil basins, and select overseas regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Tong Petrotech operates globally with significant presence in North America (Permian Basin, Rocky Mountains), China’s major oil and gas basins (Ordos, Tarim, Junggar, Sichuan), and overseas markets including Algeria, Libya, and Kazakhstan. The company’s international subsidiaries are primarily based in the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the oilfield services supply chain, providing technical services and equipment for oil and gas exploration and production activities. It acts as a service provider to upstream oil companies rather than a producer or downstream distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating core perforating technology leadership, expanding integrated drilling and completion services, and accelerating growth in clean energy and CCUS businesses. R&D focuses on intelligent perforating tools, fracturing fluid innovations, CO2 injection technologies, and modular equipment to enhance efficiency, safety, and environmental performance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of perforating equipment and provision of technical services including drilling, logging, perforating, and fracturing. The company also earns income from clean energy and CCUS project services. Sales are predominantly direct to large oil and gas operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with oilfield service providers affiliated with China’s 'Big Three' oil companies domestically and with international oilfield service firms in North America. Tong Petrotech positions itself as a technology leader in perforating services with integrated drilling and completion capabilities, leveraging innovation and global market presence to differentiate.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tong Petrotech reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 16.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 55.6 million, up 10.67%. The company has shown steady growth in both domestic and international markets, with North American revenue accounting for over 70%. Cash flow from operations remains positive and stable.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its internationally leading perforating technology, integrated one-stop drilling and completion services, and strong R&D capabilities with over 130 patents. Its ability to provide customized, efficient, and environmentally friendly solutions, including CO2 enhanced oil recovery, offers customers cost reduction, improved oil recovery, and support for green energy transitions.
